Doctor’s Comments
Mentor MemoryGel Siltex silicone breast implants were used by Dr. Gregory Park, Oceanside plastic surgeon, for this patient’s breast augmentation surgery. A 375cc high profile implant was used on the left and 350cc high profile implants was used on the right. Different sized implants were used because a previous tumor removal in the left breast resulted in volume asymmetry. The implants were placed through lowered inframammary incisions into dual plane split submuscular pockets increasing this patient’s bra size from 32A to 32D. Her before and after photos show her breast augmentation results 3 months after her surgery.
